Description: All prices treated as tax-exclusive; GST is added a second time to tax-inclusive retail prices
Reproduction steps: 1. Review pricing.service.ts calculateCartPricing line 352. 2. Calculate order for product with base price ₹1,299. 3. Observe system adds 18% GST (₹233.82) on top, making grand total ₹1,532.82 instead of extracting GST.
Expected behavior: Products configured as tax-inclusive should extract GST from the retail price without adding tax a second time.
Actual behavior: All products have GST added on top regardless of whether prices are entered inclusive or exclusive of tax.
Likely root cause: Schema lacks an isTaxInclusive flag; pricing engine calculates lineTaxTotalPaise = lineTaxablePaise * taxRate / 100 unconditionally.
Recommended correction: Add isTaxInclusive boolean to Product model; update pricing service to extract taxable base and tax components when tax-inclusive.

Description: Shipping charges omit GST tax calculation on tax invoices
Reproduction steps: 1. Generate order with shipping fee of ₹99. 2. Review pricing quote and invoice breakdown. 3. Observe shipping total is added directly to grand total without applicable 18% GST (SAC 9968).
Expected behavior: Under Indian GST law, courier/shipping fees charged to buyers are taxable at 18% and must show CGST/SGST or IGST breakup.
Actual behavior: Shipping fee is added as non-taxable straight addition to grand total (grandTotal = taxableAmount + taxTotal + shippingTotal).
Likely root cause: Shipping fee was treated as a flat add-on rather than a taxable supply of service under SAC 9968.
Recommended correction: Include shipping fee in taxable base or calculate shipping GST separately with appropriate CGST/SGST/IGST allocation.
